physicalNotes: Radius 0.27136114 Jupiter radii from Hord et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167..233H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..233H/abstract): 19,400.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.0299 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM. sources.phase: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): transit mid-time 2458383.915624 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 18 min)
sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
